title: Chameleon waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- Tail: curling spiral, starting from body rear lower right -->
    <path d='M 58 62 C 52 62 48 66 46 70 C 44 74 46 79 51 79 C 56 79 58 74 55 71 C 52 68 48 70 49 74' fill='none' stroke='#2ea86a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx='48' cy='52' rx='17' ry='11' fill='#38d67b'/>
    <!-- Belly lighter shade -->
    <ellipse cx='48' cy='57' rx='13' ry='6' fill='#a8f5c8'/>
    <!-- Back ridge spikes -->
    <path d='M 38 43 L 41 38 L 44 43 L 47 37 L 50 43 L 53 38 L 56 43' fill='#f2e14c' stroke='#f2e14c' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <!-- Back ridge lighter tint -->
    <path d='M 41 38 L 44 43 L 47 37 L 50 43 L 53 38' fill='none' stroke='#fff59a' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <!-- Back leg -->
    <path d='M 44 62 L 41 70 L 36 72 M 41 70 L 46 72' fill='none' stroke='#2ea86a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Front leg -->
    <path d='M 55 62 L 58 70 L 63 72 M 58 70 L 53 72' fill='none' stroke='#2ea86a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Front foot lighter highlight -->
    <path d='M 63 72 L 58 70 L 53 72' fill='none' stroke='#a8f5c8' stroke-width='1'/>
    <!-- Waving arm raised up on left side -->
    <path d='M 40 47 C 36 42 33 36 31 28' fill='none' stroke='#2ea86a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Waving hand -->
    <circle cx='31' cy='26' r='4.2' fill='#38d67b'/>
    <path d='M 28 24 L 26 21 M 31 22 L 31 19 M 34 24 L 37 21' fill='none' stroke='#38d67b' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Hand lighter fingertips -->
    <circle cx='26' cy='20.5' r='1.6' fill='#a8f5c8'/>
    <circle cx='31' cy='18.5' r='1.6' fill='#a8f5c8'/>
    <circle cx='37' cy='20.5' r='1.6' fill='#a8f5c8'/>
    <!-- Head -->
    <ellipse cx='58' cy='44' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#38d67b'/>
    <!-- Head crest / casque -->
    <path d='M 54 36 C 56 31 66 31 69 38 C 68 34 62 32 58 36 Z' fill='#1f8a52'/>
    <path d='M 57 34 C 60 31 65 32 67 37' fill='none' stroke='#6ef0a5' stroke-width='1'/>
    <!-- Eye -->
    <circle cx='61' cy='42' r='3.6' fill='#f2e14c'/>
    <circle cx='61' cy='42' r='2.2' fill='#1a2a1e'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='41' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- Eye ring highlight -->
    <circle cx='61' cy='42' r='3.6' fill='none' stroke='#fff59a' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <!-- Snout / mouth -->
    <path d='M 65 45 Q 70 46 68 49 Q 64 50 62 48' fill='#38d67b'/>
    <path d='M 65 47 Q 67 48 66 49' fill='none' stroke='#1f8a52' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Cheek spot -->
    <circle cx='58' cy='49' r='1.6' fill='#f7a8d8'/>
    <!-- Body spots -->
    <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='1.8' fill='#1f8a52'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='52' r='1.4' fill='#1f8a52'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='54' r='1.2' fill='#1f8a52'/>
    <!-- Curled tail tip highlight -->
    <circle cx='49' cy='74' r='1.4' fill='#6ef0a5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
